capabilities.name: Product Catalog and Discovery
capabilities.description: Allows customers to browse, search, compare, and view detailed information about products and rental items.
features: Product overview and product detail pages
Filter by category, brand, and price range
View brands, categories, product specifications, and environmental ratings

capabilities.name: Shopping Cart and Checkout
capabilities.description: Manages the customer purchase journey from adding products to completing payment.
features: Require or support sign-in during checkout
Complete checkout from web or mobile experiences

capabilities.name: Promotions and Discounts
capabilities.description: Applies promotional rules and discounts during the shopping and checkout experience.
features: Discount support in cart and checkout
Combination discounts for selected product bundles

capabilities.name: Customer Identity and Access Management
capabilities.description: Handles customer registration, authentication, account recovery, and account protection.
features: Account locking after failed login attempts
Social login with external identity providers

capabilities.name: Customer Account Management
capabilities.description: Provides self-service account features for customers after registration and purchase.
features: Access account features from supported customer channels

capabilities.name: Order and Invoice Management
capabilities.description: Tracks completed purchases and provides invoice information to customers and administrators.

capabilities.name: Customer Support and Communication
capabilities.description: Enables customers to contact the business and receive support.

capabilities.name: Administration and Back Office
capabilities.description: Gives administrators tools to manage platform data and monitor business activity.
features: Create, read, update, and delete business entities
Manage products, brands, categories, users, invoices, carts, favorites, contact requests, and product specifications

capabilities.name: Analytics and Reporting
capabilities.description: Provides insight into customer activity and operational performance.

capabilities.name: Localization and Policy Content
capabilities.description: Supports customer-facing language and policy information needs.
